scope: Spline pcalvol loose acceptance only. 3D Bayesian phi_h in the copy of fits/spline/pcalvol/loose/fit_copy.root, Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. The file has rdf, mdf, gdf, Background, and Bayesian histograms and no RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, or 5D histograms. Those families were not created. No publication. The source fit, the budget, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. This copy does not replace the source, so the source stays in the budget. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows selected by these histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 of 452 are narrower than 0.05, and the C windows have median width 0.0070 with 445 of 452 narrower than 0.05, so they can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 used the manual baseline on all 452 histograms. It improved 6 and made 24 worse. The manual window, or the second-pass half-width around a bad start, pulled bins off this histogram's cosine. The worst stored miss that pass 1 did not fix was (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8). Pass 1 moved it only from B=-0.045000 to B=-0.056440, collapsed C to 0, and changed chi-squared from 43.013 to 42.335. That is still short of this histogram's cosine B=-0.124440, C=-0.047494, chi-squared 37.506. The worst pass-1 regression was (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_16), chi-squared 20.949 to 282.446. Pass 2 put 50 starts on each histogram's own unconstrained cosine, opened only the limits that excluded that cosine, and turned off the second-pass half-width when it was narrower than the parameter error. It refit Q2-y 1 through 16. Q2-y 17 was not given new keys and did not move. Pass 3 added (1, 1), (1, 12), (1, 18), (2, 16), (8, 21), (10, 2), (10, 5), and (10, 15), where that half-width or a limit at zero still missed the cosine, and refit Q2-y 1, 2, 8, and 10. JSON still has 452 bins. 37 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is worse (largest increase 0.0008). (1, 8) is kept at B=-0.124443, statistical error 0.034630, C=-0.047496, error 0.019292, chi-squared 37.506, NDF 13, status completed, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. The stored B=-0.045 was the second-pass edge of a first-pass limit at -0.05, not the cosine. It is not pulled to the nominal B=-0.125184.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved onto the nominal value. (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_3) stays at B=-0.198917 versus nominal -0.154434. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_9) stays at B=-0.036993 rather than the nominal -0.007582. (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_14) stays at B=-0.034906 rather than the nominal -0.005860. (Q2_y_Bin_17)-(z_pT_Bin_2) is still 0.401 above the free cosine, inside the B statistical error 0.025, and was left. Excluded sector pairs were not put back into this comparison. No comparison was filled with zero. The source was not removed from the budget, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty.
